apps.name: AnythingLLM
apps.tagline: Full-Stack Desktop AI Assistant & Local RAG
apps.description: All-in-one desktop AI application that turns your documents into context for any local or hosted LLM with full privacy.

pricing.paid_tier_description: AnythingLLM Cloud hosted enterprise tier available

replaces.notes: Self-hosted RAG pipeline over local PDF, DOCX, and text repositories.

apps.name: Appwrite
apps.tagline: Secure Open Source Backend for Web, Mobile & Flutter Developers
apps.description: Self-hosted backend-as-a-service providing auth, databases, serverless functions, storage, and real-time messaging.

replaces.notes: Full end-to-end self-hosted BaaS alternative to Firebase and AWS Amplify.

apps.name: Blender
apps.tagline: Free and open-source 3D creation suite
apps.description: The industry-standard open-source 3D creation suite supporting modeling, sculpting, animation, rendering (Cycles/Eevee), compositing, motion tracking, video editing, and 2D animation (Grease Pencil).

replaces.notes: Full 3D pipeline replacement. FBX import from Maya. Steeper learning curve but comparable capabilities.
Cycles renderer competitive with Redshift. Geometry Nodes replaces MoGraph workflows.

apps.name: Bruno
apps.tagline: Fast, offline-first, Git-friendly open-source API client
apps.description: An open-source alternative to Postman and Insomnia. Bruno stores your API collections directly as files on your filesystem using plain text markup format (Bru), making them easy to version control with Git.

pricing.paid_tier_description: Optional Golden Edition for enterprise features

replaces.notes: Directly imports Postman v2 collections and environment files
Supports Insomnia v4 export JSON files

apps.name: DBeaver Community
apps.tagline: Free multi-platform database tool for developers and DBAs
apps.description: DBeaver is a universal database management tool supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Oracle, DB2, SQL Server, Sybase, MS Access, Teradata, Firebird, Derby, and over 100 JDBC-compliant databases.

pricing.paid_tier_description: Enterprise Edition available for NoSQL & cloud DB extensions

replaces.notes: Full SQL editing, ER diagrams, and connection management
Complete multi-database administrative coverage

apps.name: Ghostty
apps.tagline: Fast, feature-rich, cross-platform terminal emulator
apps.description: A GPU-accelerated terminal emulator that aims to be fast, feature-rich, and native. Uses platform-native UI and rendering with a focus on correctness and performance.

replaces.notes: GPU-rendered terminal with significantly lower latency and memory usage.

apps.name: GIMP
apps.tagline: GNU Image Manipulation Program - Free & open source image editor
apps.description: GIMP is a cross-platform image editor available for GNU/Linux, macOS, Windows and more operating systems. It is free software for photo retouching, image composition, and image authoring.

replaces.notes: Full raster manipulation and PSD file import support

apps.name: GPT4All
apps.tagline: Run Local LLMs on Any Hardware
apps.description: A free-to-use, locally running, privacy-aware desktop chatbot. No GPU required. Runs quantized models on consumer hardware with a simple installer.

replaces.notes: Run LLMs locally without GPU requirement. CPU-optimized quantized models included.

apps.name: Hoppscotch
apps.tagline: Open Source API Development Ecosystem
apps.description: Lightweight, web-first and desktop API development suite for REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, Socket.IO, and SSE testing.

replaces.notes: Seamless import of Postman collections with multi-protocol support including WebSockets.

apps.name: Inkscape
apps.tagline: Professional vector graphics editor for Linux, Windows and macOS
apps.description: Inkscape is a free and open-source vector graphics editor used to create vector images, primarily in Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) format. Ideal for illustrations, diagrams, logos, and typography.

replaces.notes: Native W3C SVG file format with Adobe Illustrator file import support

apps.name: Jan
apps.tagline: Rethinking the AI Desktop Client
apps.description: An open-source alternative to ChatGPT that runs 100% offline on your computer with local GGUF models.

replaces.notes: Runs LLMs locally with full offline privacy and local OpenAI API server compatibility.

apps.name: K3s
apps.tagline: Lightweight Kubernetes for Local & Edge Environments
apps.description: A lightweight, fully compliant Kubernetes distribution packaged as a single binary under 100MB.

replaces.notes: Lightweight local Kubernetes alternative to heavy desktop Docker/K8s runtimes.

apps.name: LazyGit
apps.tagline: Simple terminal UI for git commands
apps.description: A simple terminal UI for git commands written in Go. Provides an intuitive visual interface for staging, committing, branching, merging, and resolving conflicts without memorizing complex git CLI syntax.

replaces.notes: Terminal-native Git GUI alternative. Keyboard-driven, zero overhead.

apps.name: LibreChat
apps.tagline: Enhanced ChatGPT Clone with Multi-Provider Support
apps.description: An open-source ChatGPT-style interface supporting multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, local models via Ollama). Features conversations, presets, plugins, and multi-user support.

replaces.notes: ChatGPT conversation import supported. Connects to local Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible API.

apps.name: LM Studio
apps.tagline: Discover, download, and run local LLMs offline on Mac, Windows, and Linux
apps.description: LM Studio is a desktop application that lets you run local LLMs such as Llama 3, Mistral, and Phi-3 offline. Provides a sleek chat UI, HuggingFace model downloader, and local OpenAI-compatible HTTP server.

replaces.notes: 100% offline desktop AI assistant utilizing open-weights models

apps.name: Logseq
apps.tagline: Privacy-first, open-source knowledge management
apps.description: A privacy-first, open-source platform for knowledge management and collaboration. Uses a local-first, outliner-based approach with bidirectional linking, graph views, and Markdown/Org-mode files.

pricing.paid_tier_description: Logseq Sync for encrypted cloud synchronization

replaces.notes: Local-first privacy alternative. Markdown-based with bidirectional links and graph views.

apps.name: Meilisearch
apps.tagline: Lightning-Fast Open Source Search Engine
apps.description: Ultra-fast, typo-tolerant, and open-source search engine designed for smooth instant search UI experiences.

replaces.notes: Direct open-source replacement for Algolia with instant typo-tolerant search APIs.

apps.name: OBS Studio
apps.tagline: Free and open-source software for live streaming and recording
apps.description: Industry-standard open-source software for video recording and live streaming. Supports high-performance real-time video/audio capturing, scene composition, encoding, and broadcasting to platforms like Twitch, YouTube, and custom RTMP servers.

replaces.notes: Streamlabs is itself a fork of OBS. Scene collection export/import fully compatible.

apps.name: Ollama
apps.tagline: Get up and running with Llama 3, Mistral, and other large language models locally
apps.description: Ollama allows you to run open-source large language models (LLMs) locally on macOS, Linux, and Windows. Includes a simple CLI, OpenAI-compatible REST API, and efficient model quantization support.

replaces.notes: Exposes standard OpenAI /v1/chat/completions endpoint for local inference

apps.name: Open WebUI
apps.tagline: Self-Hosted WebUI for LLMs and Ollama
apps.description: A user-friendly self-hosted WebUI designed for running LLMs locally with Ollama, supporting chat history, model switching, RAG pipelines, and user management.

replaces.notes: Local Ollama-powered ChatGPT experience with document upload and RAG support.

apps.name: OpenTofu
apps.tagline: Open Source Infrastructure as Code Engine
apps.description: An open-source, community-driven fork of Terraform governed by the Linux Foundation for managing infrastructure as code.

replaces.notes: Drop-in replacement for Terraform supporting existing state files and HCL configurations.

apps.name: Penpot
apps.tagline: Open Source Design & Prototyping Platform
apps.description: The first open-source web-based design and prototyping tool built natively on open web standards (SVG, CSS Grid).

replaces.notes: Native SVG and CSS grid design tool built for seamless designer-developer collaboration.

apps.name: PocketBase
apps.tagline: Open Source backend in 1 file with real-time database, auth, and file storage
apps.description: PocketBase is an open-source Go backend consisting of embedded SQLite database with real-time subscriptions, built-in user management, file storage, and an intuitive admin dashboard.

replaces.notes: Replaces Firestore real-time DB, Auth, and Storage with zero-cost self-hosted single binary

apps.name: Podman
apps.tagline: Daemonless, rootless open-source container engine
apps.description: Podman is a daemonless container engine for developing, managing, and running OCI Containers on your Linux System or macOS/Windows via Podman Desktop. Podman provides a Docker-compatible CLI.

replaces.notes: Drop-in alias `alias docker=podman` supports standard Dockerfiles and Compose

apps.name: Supabase
apps.tagline: Open Source Firebase Alternative
apps.description: An open-source Firebase alternative providing Postgres database, Authentication, Instant APIs, Realtime subscriptions, Functions, and Storage.

replaces.notes: Provides relational Postgres alternative to Firestore NoSQL with built-in auth and realtime.

apps.name: SurrealDB
apps.tagline: The Ultimate Multi-Model Cloud Database
apps.description: Multi-model database combining relational, document, graph, vector, and geospatial capabilities with SurrealQL.

replaces.notes: Consolidates document, relational, graph, and vector database workloads into a single engine.

apps.name: Valkey
apps.tagline: High-performance Open-Source In-Memory Data Store
apps.description: An open-source high-performance in-memory datastore created by former Redis core contributors under Linux Foundation.

replaces.notes: Drop-in open-source replacement for Redis supporting exact command set and protocol.

apps.name: VSCodium
apps.tagline: Free and open-source binaries of VS Code without telemetry or tracking
apps.description: VSCodium is a community-driven release of Microsoft's VS Code editor. It builds clean, open-source binaries without proprietary Microsoft telemetry, tracking, or telemetry licenses.

replaces.notes: Uses identical settings.json and extension format; Open VSX Registry replaces Microsoft Marketplace

apps.name: Zed
apps.tagline: High-performance multiplayer code editor
apps.description: A high-performance, collaborative code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter. Built in Rust with GPU-accelerated rendering for instant responsiveness and built-in real-time collaboration.

replaces.notes: VS Code keybinding and extension import available. GPU-accelerated performance advantage.
